decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith Listed Building Consent: Application form, Heritage Appraisal and PPS5 Statement, Extract from Design and Access Statement, Addendum Design and Access Statement, Drawings: A2190 340 P3 Gatehouse Existing Ground Floor Plan, A2190 341 P3 Gatehouse Exiting Roof Plan, A2190 342 P1 Gatehouse Existing Elevation, A2190 343 P2 Gatehouse Existing Section , A2190 344 P3 Gatehouse Proposed Ground Floor Alterations, A2190 345 P2 Gatehouse Proposed Roof Plan Alterations, A2190 346 P1 Gatehouse Proposed Elevation Alteration, A2190 347 P3 Gatehouse Proposed section alteration, A2190 348 P4 Gatehouse Proposed Ground Floor, A2190 349 P3 Gatehouse Proposed Roof Plan, A2190 350 P4 Gatehouse Proposed Elevation, A2190 351 P3 Gatehouse Proposed Section, A2190 608 P1 Proposed Alterations to Listed Wall, A2190 609 P1 Proposed Alterations to Listed Wall, 3907 Aworth Gatehouse Survey Ground Floor Plan,3907 Aworth Gatehouse Survey Elevations 
 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings. Neither does it permit any further encroachment into the bund and filter beds
Condition : 5 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls in the gatehouse, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
Condition : 6 - The rainwater goods and vents utilised in the development hereby permitted shall be cast iron and coloured black and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 7 - Details of the window frames, doors and rooflights to be utilised in the development hereby permitted, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. Such details shall indicate, at a scale of not less
than 1:20, the longitudinal and cross-sectional detailing, cill and lintol detailing, and means of opening. The frames shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 8 - Detailed 1:20 drawings of the finished wall reveals and decorative finish surrounding the new openings in the listed  wall, including bricks, pointing and mortar finish shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. Such details shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so maintained.
description: Refurbishment of the existing listed Gatehouse and alterations to the existing listed boundary wall
